hero.title: The Story Behind the Brand
hero.description: Brendia Pro® was born from a passion for excellence and a desire to share the art of weft extensions with stylists who want more. What began as a personal professional journey is now becoming a platform for education, growth and a new generation of extension specialists.

founder.name: Nikolina Kljaić
bio: With over a decade of experience in the hair extension industry, Nikolina has dedicated her career to perfecting the art of weft extensions and sharing her expertise with others.

Her journey began in a small salon, where her natural talent and relentless pursuit of perfection quickly set her apart. Clients traveled from across the country to experience her transformative work, and fellow stylists began asking to learn her techniques.

"I realized that my impact could go far beyond my own chair," Nikolina shares. "By teaching others, I could help other stylists build successful careers while giving their clients the confidence that comes with beautiful hair."

Today, Nikolina leads Brendia Pro® with the same passion and attention to detail that defined her work from day one. Every course, every lesson, every interaction reflects her commitment to excellence and genuine care for her students' success.

faqs.question: Who is the Brendia Pro® education intended for?
faqs.answer: The Brendia Pro® education is intended for hairdressers who want to expand their knowledge, refine their technique of working with extensions, and elevate the quality of their services to the next level.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Artist and Advanced Artist?
faqs.answer:
The Artist education represents the foundation of the Brendia Pro® technique and focuses on acquiring the key knowledge and skills needed for proper work.

The Advanced Artist education is intended for those who want to take a step further, perfect their technique, and master more advanced working methods.

faqs.question: Do I need prior experience working with extensions?
faqs.answer: No. All you need is to be a licensed hairdresser.

faqs.question: How long does it take to complete the online course?
faqs.answer: Since you have access to the modules for one year, you should complete the course within that period.

faqs.question: Do I need to purchase additional materials?
faqs.answer: No. For the practical part of the Brendia Pro® education, you will receive all the materials needed for practice, except the mannequin head.

faqs.question: Is in-person education available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Brendia Pro® offers in-person education, with details and dates arranged individually.

faqs.question: How do I become certified?
faqs.answer: Once you complete all the education modules, contact the educator, who will guide you through the next steps required to earn your certificate.

faqs.question: What do I get when I enroll?
faqs.answer: By enrolling, you get access to the online education modules, a starter kit, support throughout the learning process, a mobile app so you can connect at any time, and the opportunity to earn a certificate after successfully completing the education.

faqs.question: What payment options are available?
faqs.answer: You can pay for the Brendia Pro® education in a single payment or choose an installment plan, whichever suits you best.

faqs.question: Is there a refund policy?
faqs.answer: Once access to the education has been activated, payments are non-refundable.

faqs.question: When do I get access to the education?
faqs.answer: After successful enrollment and confirmed payment, you will receive access to the education platform via email and can start learning.

faqs.question: How long do I have access to the education?
faqs.answer:
Access to the Brendia Pro® education is available for one year, giving you plenty of time to learn, practice, and revisit the content.

You can access the community and the website for as long as you need.

faqs.question: Can I rewatch modules I have already completed?
faqs.answer: Yes. For the duration of your access to the education, you can return to previously completed modules and review the content whenever you need.

faqs.question: Can I contact the educator if I have questions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Throughout the education, you can communicate with the educator, who can help you with questions and concerns about the technique and your progress.
